resources.string: Mark news channels: hold a video card and pick “Mark as news channel”; their newest videos show up here. Or add a topic in the feed controls: its newest videos come too.
Added to the end of the queue
Tap: watch · up: queue · down: close
New: spread two fingers on the home for the news
News: spread two fingers on the home

Spread two fingers apart on the home and the news open as a slideshow: the newest videos of your news channels and your topics, one card each. Swipe sideways for the next, tap to watch, swipe up for the end of the queue, pinch, swipe down or press back to close. Mark a news channel by holding a video card.
